name: Collection grid
description: A collection's products as a filterable, sortable card grid, with a filter sidebar on wide layouts and a filter drawer on narrow ones.

fields.name: What to list
fields.helpText: collection (the default) lists one collection — the one picked below, or the collection this page's route resolved. catalogue lists every product in the store, which is what the All products page uses; the Collection picker and the Collection filter group both still apply.

fields.name: Collection
fields.helpText: Leave empty on a collection page to use that collection. Ignored when What to list is catalogue.

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: sidebar is the default. drawer-only gives the grid the full width at every size.

fields.name: Columns
fields.helpText: The default column count on wide layouts. Shoppers can change it.

fields.name: Pagination style
fields.helpText: load-more keeps the footer reachable; pages numbers the results.

fields.name: Sort options
fields.helpText: Which sort options to offer, in order.

fields.name: Filter groups
fields.helpText: Filter groups, in order. Values and counts come from the store.

fields.name: Source
fields.helpText: What the group filters on. "options" is one group per variant option the store has (Size, Colour, Fabric…), labelled and ordered by the store itself — pick a single "option:…" instead only to rename one or pin where it sits. A group the storefront cannot narrow by in this grid's scope is not shown to shoppers: "collection" is one such group on a grid that already shows a collection, since the catalogue has no way to ask for products in both.

fields.name: Start closed
fields.helpText: A group with an active value always starts open.

fields.name: Price slider
fields.helpText: Off shows the price group's two typed fields alone, for prices that sit in a few tight clusters.

fields.name: Price step
fields.helpText: The price slider's step. Leave empty for one unit of the store currency (ISK 100, USD 1).

fields.name: Empty title
fields.helpText: Shown when no product matches the filters.

fields.name: Empty text
fields.helpText: The block appends a sentence naming the active filters.
